svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lock pin tabs, make 2: 30 x 6 bar, about 40 long, one end shaped

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: to sit on the back of the fork blade. Drill 10.5 mm, 20 from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: that end. Weld one to the inner and one to the outer blade of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the left rear fork, 200 above and 60 behind the axle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Jig both tabs with a 10 mm bar through both holes so they line up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Torque-arm tab, make 1: 30 x 6 bar 60 long (40 high), 11 mm hole

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 50 behind the axle; weld to the back of the outer blade of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: right rear fork, centred 60 above the axle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Steel forks only. Clean off paint, short welds, no undercut on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the blade; let them cool in air. Paint after.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the 10 mm pin slides through both tabs with the wheel out.
